verdict.rationale: A probe found an official, first-party MCP server documented in Atlassian's own GitHub org (atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server), so an agent can connect to Jira through it. The evidence is a single probe hit and says nothing about scope, auth, or supported clients. Rovo AI and the REST APIs are adjacent features and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's tools, auth flow and supported agent clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
